_doc: HYP-03 pre-registration for SHIFT and WIDTH placebo sweeps. Committed before any placebo runs. Scope decision (hyp03_scope_decision.json) deferred this until HYP-04 results were known; HYP-04 is now complete.
title: The opening range is not a special level — SHIFT and WIDTH placebo sweeps

SHIFT.description: Opening range window shifted 60 minutes later than the real range. Range bars: open+60 to open+60+rm. Detection window: open+60+rm onward. Destroys the privileged status of the open.
SHIFT.note: If breakout rate above SHIFT band matches the real level, the open is not special — timing explains nothing.

WIDTH.description: Same-width band centered on the close price at the end of the real range window (bar at open+rm-1). Level location changes; width is preserved. Destroys range location while preserving stop/target size.
WIDTH.note: If breakout rate matches, range width (stop and target size) explains the whole result and the boundary location carries nothing.

placebos.ROTATE: DEFERRED — requires OHLC-preserving tuple decomposition (IMPROVEMENTS §6.8). Most informative placebo; run if SHIFT and WIDTH both fail to match the real range.
placebos.PRIOR: SKIPPED — inherits yesterday's volatility, which correlates with today's. Weakest placebo.

primary_statistic.definition: fraction of session-days where at least one II entry fires (real or placebo)
primary_statistic.rationale: trigger rate is the most informative and least friction-confounded check: if the real range is broken no more often than a same-width placebo band, the level premise fails before expectancy is consulted

secondary_statistics: E[gross_r] per (instrument, session) paired against placebo
path_efficiency: median |exit_r| / session_range for triggered days

inference.test: paired permutation test at the day level
inference.permutation_unit: session-day (real/placebo label exchangeable within each day)
inference.joint: maxT correction across instrument-sessions for multiplicity

period: holdout only (2026-02-01 onward) for primary; full sample as sensitivity

kill_criterion_for_hyp05.condition: SHIFT trigger_rate == real AND WIDTH trigger_rate == real (neither Holm-adjusted p < 0.05)
kill_criterion_for_hyp05.action: close HYP-05 unrun; level is not special

continue_criterion.condition: at least one of SHIFT or WIDTH shows significantly lower trigger rate than real (Holm p < 0.05)
continue_criterion.action: proceed to HYP-05; level carries information that the placebo does not

rotate_decision.if_shift_or_width_worse: SHIFT or WIDTH is distinguishable from real -> ROTATE is needed to close the volatility-regime confound; add to backlog
rotate_decision.if_both_match: ROTATE not needed; level not special

data: holdout parquet cache already on disk; no API calls, no spend
